summary: Proposal Phase 1 — Task 1 (FOUNDATION). Additive: three nullable period columns on quote_lines (period_start / period_end / period_label) so a proposal line can pin an EXACT compliance period, and a re-issue of the single-source job engine lifecycle_materialize_jobs so it consumes the line's explicit period when present. Backward-compatible: NULL line periods (every pre-existing line) fall through to the historical computed period unchanged. Function re-issued from the LIVE body (catalog_functions include_source, def hash bb4b609f86e88ec7606363147483065f), preserving all other logic byte-for-byte; the only change is a COALESCE override after the existing period-computation block.

problem.motivation: Every other Phase 1 task writes per-period quote_lines (SA per tax year, Accounts per CH period, VAT per stagger period, MTD quarterly/annual/SA as separate jobs). The engine must consume the line's period instead of computing a single one from CURRENT_DATE.
problem.engine_decision: lifecycle_materialize_jobs -> lifecycle_upsert_job_with_deadlines is the confirmed single source of truth for job+deadline creation (src/test/regression/job-creation-single-source.test.ts enforces it). This change is additive to that engine only; no second engine introduced.
problem.based_on: LIVE body fetched via claude.ai AccountancyOS Lovable MCP catalog_functions(include_source), not the git file, to respect known live-vs-git divergence.

expected_objects.object: A quote_line carrying an explicit period materializes a job whose period_label equals the line's period_label (not the computed one)
expected_objects.verify_via: Behavioural: create a quote with one quote_line whose period_start/period_end/period_label are set to an explicit period distinct from today's computed period (e.g. an SA line labelled '2023/24' when the current tax year computes '2025/26'); run lifecycle_materialize_jobs for that quote; db_select public.jobs for the created job and confirm its period_label = '2023/24'. Then create a control line with NULL period columns and confirm it still materializes the computed period_label (backward-compat).
expected_objects.deferred_reason: No caller yet writes non-NULL line periods (per this receipt's own risk note). The behavioural check will be exercised end-to-end by Phase 1 Tasks 3–6 (SA multi-year, CH accounts period, VAT stagger periods, MTD split) which are the first writers of explicit line periods. The COALESCE override is a one-line change over a byte-for-byte re-issue of the LIVE body, and both static gates (columns present; engine body reads v_line.period_start/label) are verified above.

risks: period_label participates in the job dedup key (org, service_code, entity, period_label). Explicit labels chosen by later Phase 1 tasks (e.g. 'YYYY/YY' for SA, CH year-end labels) intentionally differ from the engine's computed labels, so they will NOT collide with computed jobs — a distinct label is a distinct job, which is the desired per-period behaviour. Care is only needed if a future caller supplies a label byte-identical to what the engine would have computed for the SAME period — that is a de-dup (same job), which is correct.
This migration only makes the engine CAPABLE of honouring line periods; no caller yet writes non-NULL period columns, so live behaviour is unchanged until later Phase 1 tasks populate them.
